June 12, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Epoch Investment Partners Inc decreased its stake in Raytheon Co (RTN) by 2.28% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Epoch Investment Partners Inc sold 14,659 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.91% with the market. The institutional investor held 627,320 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $135.39M, down from 641,979 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Epoch Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Raytheon Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $59.64 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.32% or $4.93 during the last trading session, reaching $207.62. About 570,291 shares traded. Raytheon Company (NYSE:RTN) has risen 29.53% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.96% the S&P500.
